name: Chirag Mahendru
title: 3D Environment Artist
subtitle: Maya - Blender - Unreal Engine - Substance Painter - 3ds Max
bio: Punjab-based 3D Environment Artist with a passion for building immersive, believable worlds. I specialize in modeling, texturing, lighting, and rendering — turning concepts into visually compelling game-ready and cinematic environments. My workflow spans Unreal Engine, Maya, Blender, Substance Painter  with a strong focus on PBR texturing, hard-surface modeling, and environment storytelling. I care about the small details that make a scene feel real — from material response under light to the layout choices that guide a viewer's eye.
